body.translated_text: <s>Nādabindūpaniṣat</s> (The Upaniṣad on Sound and the Drop)

children.text: oṃ
children.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>.

children.text: akāro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣa ukāras tūttaraḥ smṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: The letter 'a' is the right wing; the letter 'u' is remembered as the left;

children.text: makāras tasya pucchaṃ vā ardhamātrā śiras tathā || 1 ||
children.translated_text: the letter 'm' is its tail; and the half-measure (<s>ardhamātrā</s>) is likewise the head. (1)

children.text: pādau rajas tamas tasya śarīraṃ sattvam ucyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s> are its feet; <s>sattva</s> is said to be its body;

children.text: dharmaś ca dakṣiṇaṃ cakṣur adharmaś cottaraṃ smṛtam || 2 ||
children.translated_text: <s>dharma</s> is its right eye, and <s>adharma</s> is remembered as its left. (2)

children.text: bhūr lokaḥ pādayos tasya bhuvar lokas tu jānunoḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhūrloka</s> (earthly world) is at its feet; the <s>Bhuvarloka</s> (atmospheric world) is at its knees;

children.text: svar lokaḥ kaṭideśe tu nābhideśe mahar jagat || 3 ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Svarloka</s> (heavenly world) is at its waist; and the <s>Maharloka</s> (great world) is at its navel region. (3)

children.text: janalokas tu hṛdaye kaṇṭhadeśe tapas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>Janaloka</s> (world of beings) is at its heart; the <s>Tapoloka</s> (world of austerity) is at its throat;

children.text: bhruvor lalāṭamadhye tu satyaloko vyavasthitaḥ || 4 ||
children.translated_text: and the <s>Satyaloka</s> (world of truth) is established between the brows and the forehead. (4)

children.text: sahasram iti cātra mantra eva pradarśitaḥ /
children.translated_text: The thousand[-headed hymn] is indicated here in this very <s>mantra</s>;

children.text: evam enaṃ samārūḍho haṃsaṃ yogavicakṣaṇaḥ || 5 ||
children.translated_text: thus, one skilled in <s>yoga</s>, having mounted upon this <s>haṃsa</s> (the sacred syllable as a swan) — (5)

children.text: na badhyate karmacārī pāpakoṭiśatair api /
children.translated_text: though performing actions, is not bound even by hundreds of <s>koṭis</s> of sins.

children.text: āgneyī prathamā mātrā vāyavyaiṣā vaśānugā || 6 ||
children.translated_text: The first <s>mātrā</s> (measure) belongs to <s>Agni</s> (fire); the second is subject to <s>Vāyu</s> (wind); (6)

children.text: bhānumaṇḍalasaṃkāśā bhaven mātrā tathottarā /
children.translated_text: the upper <s>mātrā</s>, resembling the orb of the sun, is [the third];

children.text: paramā cārdhamātrā ca vāruṇīṃ tāṃ vidur budhāḥ || 7 ||
children.translated_text: and the supreme half-measure (<s>ardhamātrā</s>) — the wise know that to be of <s>Varuṇa</s>. (7)

children.text: kalātrayānanā vāpi tāsāṃ mātrāpratiṣṭhitā /
children.translated_text: Residing in the three <s>kalās</s> (parts), the <s>mātrā</s> is established in them;

children.text: eṣa oṃkāra ākhyāto dhāraṇābhir nibodhata || 8 ||
children.translated_text: this <s>Oṃkāra</s> is thus declared — understand it through concentrations (<s>dhāraṇās</s>). (8)

children.text: yoṣiṇī prathamā mātrā vidyunmālā tathāparā /
children.translated_text: The first <s>mātrā</s> is called <s>Yoṣiṇī</s> (woman); the second is <s>Vidyunmālā</s> (garland of lightning);

children.text: pataṃgī ca tṛtīyā syāc caturthī vāyuveginī || 9 ||
children.translated_text: the third is <s>Pataṃgī</s> (moth/bird); and the fourth is <s>Vāyuveginī</s> (swift as wind). (9)

children.text: pañcamīnām adheyā ca ṣaṣṭhī caindrī vidhīyate /
children.translated_text: The fifth is called <s>Nāmadheya</s>; the sixth is designated as <s>Aindrī</s> (of <s>Indra</s>);

children.text: saptamī vaiṣṇavī nāma śaṃkarī ca tathāṣṭamī || 10 ||
children.translated_text: the seventh is named <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> (of <s>Viṣṇu</s>); and the eighth is <s>Śaṃkarī</s> (of <s>Śaṅkara</s>). (10)

children.text: navamī mahatī nāma dhruveti daśamī matā /
children.translated_text: The ninth is named <s>Mahatī</s> (the great); the tenth is considered <s>Dhruvā</s> (the fixed);

children.text: ekādaśī bhaven maunī brāhmīti dvādaśī matā || 11 ||
children.translated_text: the eleventh is <s>Maunī</s> (the silent); and the twelfth is considered <s>Brāhmī</s> (of <s>Brahman</s>). (11)

children.text: prathamāyāṃ tu mātrāyāṃ yadi prāṇair viyujyate /
children.translated_text: If one departs from the vital breaths (<s>prāṇas</s>) at the first <s>mātrā</s>,

children.text: sa rājā bhārate varṣe sārvabhaumaḥ prajāyate || 12 ||
children.translated_text: he is born as a universal sovereign (<s>sārvabhauma</s>) king in the land of <s>Bhārata</s>. (12)

children.text: dvitīyāyāṃ samutkrānto bhaved yakṣo mahātmavān /
children.translated_text: One who departs at the second becomes a great-souled <s>yakṣa</s>;

children.text: vidyādharas tṛtīyāyāṃ gandharvas tu caturthikām || 13 ||
children.translated_text: at the third, a <s>vidyādhara</s>; at the fourth, a <s>gandharva</s>. (13)

children.text: pañcamyām atha mātrāyāṃ yadi prāṇair viyujyate /
children.translated_text: And if one departs from the vital breaths at the fifth <s>mātrā</s>,

children.text: uṣitaḥ sahadevatvaṃ somaloke mahīyate || 14 ||
children.translated_text: having dwelt together with the gods, one is honored in the world of <s>Soma</s> (the moon). (14)

children.text: ṣaṣṭhyām indrasya sāyujyaṃ saptamyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
children.translated_text: At the sixth, union with <s>Indra</s>; at the seventh, the station of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: aṣṭamyāṃ vrajate rudraṃ paśūnāṃ ca patiṃ tathā || 15 ||
children.translated_text: at the eighth, one goes to <s>Rudra</s>, the Lord of Creatures (<s>Paśupati</s>). (15)

children.text: navamyāṃ ca maharlokaṃ daśamyāṃ ca dhruvaṃ vrajet /
children.translated_text: At the ninth, to <s>Maharloka</s>; at the tenth, one goes to <s>Dhruva</s> (the Pole Star);

children.text: ekādaśyāṃ tapolokaṃ dvādaśyāṃ brahma śāśvatam || 16 ||
children.translated_text: at the eleventh, to <s>Tapoloka</s>; at the twelfth, to eternal <s>Brahman</s>. (16)

children.text: tataḥ paraṃ śuddhaṃ vyāpakaṃ niṣkalaṃ śivam /
children.translated_text: Beyond that is the pure, all-pervading, undivided, auspicious (<s>Śiva</s>),

children.text: sadoditaṃ paraṃ brahma jyotiṣām udayo yataḥ || 17 ||
children.translated_text: the ever-risen supreme <s>Brahman</s>, from which the luminaries arise. (17)

children.text: atīndriyaṃ guṇātītaṃ mano līnaṃ yadā bhavet /
children.translated_text: When the mind, beyond the senses, transcending the <s>guṇas</s>, becomes absorbed,

children.text: anaupamyam abhāvaṃ ca yogayuktaṃ tadādiśet || 18 ||
children.translated_text: one should realize that which is beyond comparison and beyond [ordinary] existence, united with <s>yoga</s>. (18)

children.text: tadbhaktas tatsamāsaktaḥ śanair muñcet kalevaram /
children.translated_text: Devoted to That, absorbed in That, one should gradually release the body,

children.text: susthito yogacāreṇa sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ || 19 ||
children.translated_text: well-established through the practice of <s>yoga</s>, free from all attachments. (19)

children.text: tato vilīnapāśo 'sau vimalaḥ kevalaḥ prabhuḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, with bonds dissolved, he becomes pure, solitary, and sovereign;

children.text: tenaiva brahmabhāvena paramānandam aśnute || 20 ||
children.translated_text: through that very state of identity with <s>Brahman</s>, he attains supreme bliss (<s>paramānanda</s>). (20)
